title: Origins: Total Wipe
description: Origins: Total Wipe removes all of the original origins, including the Human.
body:
Origins: Total Wipe does one thing and one thing only; it removes all 10 of apace100's original origins, including the Human, to allow mod developers and modpack makers to play with solely custom origins.
Credit to JammingDino for [Remove Base Origins](https://modrinth.com/mod/remove-base-origins), the inspiration for this project.
